She [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Bug}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She gives the {{badge|Bug}} to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her. ==In the core series games== ===Character and role=== ===Pokémon X and Y=== [[File:Viola Gym Battle XY.png|thumb|left|250px|Viola challenging the player]] Viola is the first Gym Leader to be challenged by the [[Player character|player]]. {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her will be given the {{badge|Bug}}, along with {{TM|83|Infestation}}. She is the younger sister of [[Alexa]], a reporter based in the Kalos region.''"Oh, Viola! Viola is the Gym Leader of Santalune City. Not only is she an expert with Bug-type Pokémon, but she’s also an up-and-coming photography pro! Her older sister, Alexa, happens to be a reporter!"'' She is also seemingly good friends with fellow Gym Leader [[Valerie]], who gifted her the barrette that her hair is tied in for her birthday.''"Hooray! Viola has arrived! She’s fabulous! So fabulous! I’m so crazy about those eyebrows! The barrette that Viola always wears is a birthday gift from Valerie!"'' As well as being a Gym Leader, Viola is a professional photographer. According to the [[television]] show ''Gym Freaks'', Viola's camera was a birthday gift from Alexa.''"Oooh... Ahhh... Viola has arrived! She’s fabulous! So fabulous! I’m so crazy about those eyebrows! The camera that Viola always has is a birthday gift from her sister, Alexa. Awww. If I was born again, I’d like to be the camera."'' She seems to massively enjoy photography, often speaking with analogies surrounding cameras or photography in general. Her work, such as "To be Evolved" and "Nectar's Siren Song" can be found on the first floor of the Santalune Gym. Viola says "fantastic" frequently, both in Pokémon X and Y, as well as in [[Pokémon Masters EX]], where she pronounces it as "fantastique" with a French accent.''"You and your Pokémon have shown me a whole new depth of field! Fantastic! Just fantastic!"'' ===Appearance=== [[File:Viola concept art.png|thumb|200px|Viola's concept art]] Viola is a slim woman of seemingly average height. She has sandy blonde hair, which she wears in a rather unique hairstyle; being loosely tied into a barrette at the back, with two strands at the front left untied which curl tightly at the ends, making them resemble [[wp:Antenna_(biology)|antennae]]. Viola wears a slightly cropped white tank top, green cargo pants that have a white waistband, and grey boots with green laces. She carries two cameras - one around her neck, and one to her side. Her official concept artwork depicts an alternate outfit for her, consisting of what seems to be a more formal top, and her hair more neatly tied into a ponytail. While this outfit does not appear in [[Pokémon X and Y]], she was portrayed with the same ponytail in {{aniseries|XY}}, as well as in her Holiday 2023 Outfit in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. {{left clear}} {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Viola/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Viola anime.png|thumb|250px|Viola in {{aniseries|XY}}]] ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== Viola was first mentioned in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]'', albeit not by name, when [[Alexa]] revealed to {{Ash}} that her sister was a Gym Leader from the Kalos region. ===={{aniseries|XY}}==== When Ash arrived in Kalos in ''[[XY001|Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!]]'', he learned that Viola was absent from her Gym at Santalune City. However, Ash decided to head to [[Santalune Gym]] anyway after his challenge at [[Lumiose Gym]] was declined. [[XY005|He arrived there]] just as Viola, who was revealed to a professional photographer known for her excellent shots of Bug-type Pokémon, was returning and she accepted Ash's challenge. Viola's {{p|Surskit}} and {{p|Vivillon}} had a type disadvantage against [[Ash's Fletchling]] and {{AP|Pikachu}}, however Viola's strategy was to immobilize both Pokémon using {{m|Ice Beam}} and {{m|Sticky Web}}. This worked and Ash lost the battle. In ''[[XY006|Battling on Thin Ice!]]'', Ash challenged Viola to a [[rematch]]. Thanks to the training Ash had with {{ashfr}} between the battles, he was able to counter Viola's strategies and defeat her, winning himself the {{badge|Bug}}. She later reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY012|To Catch a Pokémon Smuggler!]]''. In ''[[XY020|Breaking Titles at the Chateau!]]'', Viola reunited with Ash and his friends at the [[Battle Chateau]]. There, she and Surskit battled [[Grant]] and his {{p|Onix}}, and lost. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Viola watched {{an|Serena}}'s Master Class [[Pokémon Showcase]] along with Alexa. She appeared in a fantasy in ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]'', when Ash was talking to [[Everett]] about the Gym Leaders that he had defeated in Kalos, in order for him to be able to compete in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', Viola was seen watching [[Lysandre]]'s broadcast from Lumiose City along with Alexa. In ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'' and ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'', Viola and Vivillon were among those who helped destroy the [[Giant Rock]]. She appeared again in flashbacks in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]''. ====Character==== Like her sister, Viola is very cheerful and friendly but has an unwavering focus in battle. According to Alexa, her trips away from the Santalune Gym often last for some time. She helps Alexa with her work at times and she shares a friendship with Grant, though she is shown to get easily annoyed whenever Grant falls from the walls he is climbing on. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Viola's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Viola |pkmn=Surskit |type1=Bug |type2=Water |img=Viola Surskit.png |epnum=XY005 |epname=A Blustery Santalune Gym Battle! |vajp= |vaen=Eileen Stevens |desc={{p|Surskit}} is Viola's first known Pokémon. It was first used against [[Ash's Pikachu]] in their first Gym battle. Surskit defeated Pikachu by freezing the battlefield with Ice Beam, which prevented him from moving properly and left him unable to escape Surskit's Signal Beam. Next, it fought {{AP|Fletchling}}, who quickly defeated Surskit due to its ability to fly. In ''[[XY006|Battling on Thin Ice!]]'', Surskit battled Pikachu again in a rematch, where its previous tactics failed due to Pikachu using his tail to balance himself on the ice. It was eventually defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Surskit reappeared in ''[[XY020|Breaking Titles at the Chateau!]]'', where it battled [[Grant]]'s {{p|Onix}} but lost. It appeared in flashbacks in ''[[XY021|A PokeVision of Things to Come!]]'' and ''[[XY023|Coming Back into the Cold]]''. Surskit's known moves are {{m|Protect}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, {{m|Signal Beam}}, {{m|Sticky Web}}, and {{m|Bubble Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Viola |pkmn=Vivillon |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Viola Vivillon.png |epnum=XY005 |epname=A Blustery Santalune Gym Battle! |vajp=Aya Endō |vaen=Eileen Stevens |desc={{p|Vivillon}} is Viola's second known Pokémon. It was first used against Ash in their first Gym battle. It was sent out to battle {{AP|Fletchling}} after it defeated Surskit. It won the battle by using Psychic to trap Fletchling in Surskit's {{m|Sticky Web}}, leaving it defenseless to Vivillon's Solar Beam. In ''[[XY006|Battling on Thin Ice!]]'', Vivillon faced Fletchling again in a rematch, where it beat Fletchling again by hitting it with Sleep Powder, leaving it defenseless to Solar Beam once more. Then it fought {{AP|Pikachu}}, where Vivillon was defeated after its wing was frozen by the ice surrounding the Gym, hindering its ability to fly and leaving it an easy target for Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY012|To Catch a Pokemon Smuggler!]]''. It appeared again in ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'' and ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]'', where it helped destroy the [[Giant Rock]]. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]''. Cao Thụy Thanh Hồng ([[XY135]]-[[XY136]]) }} ===GOTCHA!=== Viola briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Viola Korrina Adventures.png|thumb|right|250px|Viola in Pokémon Adventures]] Viola makes her first appearance in the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}, where she goes to [[Vaniville Town]] with Alexa to interview up-and-coming {{tc|Sky Trainer}} {{adv|Y}}. Y angrily reveals her hatred for reporters after they caused her friend {{adv|X}} to become a shut-in and refuse to leave his house despite his friends' constant efforts. Before they can continue, the Legendary Pokémon {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}} appear and begin destroying the town while fighting each other. When Viola wonders if the two are actually even Pokémon, Alexa states that she isn't sure either but notes that according to a 3,000 year old legend, Xerneas and Yveltal appear every 1,000 years. When X's group arrives in [[Santalune City]], Viola meets up with them again. Although previous encounters with [[Team Flare]] made X and his friends wary of adults, Viola reveals her position as a Gym Leader and offers to help the group by letting them see her photos of the Vaniville Town incident and offers sanctuary at her Gym. X and his friends agree to trust her, except for Shauna who runs off after getting mad at everyone for disregarding their earlier pact to not trust adults. At the Gym, Viola challenges X to a battle, which she ends up losing. They are interrupted by [[Celosia]] of Team Flare, who possesses Shauna and uses her to attack Y. Viola pushes Y out of the way, but ends up getting hit as a result. Viola reveals herself to still be conscious and reveals that he saw X's attempt to use Mega Evolution earlier and called fellow Gym Leader [[Korrina]] to help him learn more about it. When Celosia attempts to run off, Viola has her {{p|Surskit}} stop Celosia in her tracks with {{m|Sticky Web}}. Once Celosia was driven away, everyone regrouped back at the Gym where Viola had her head injury bandaged up. Later, Viola calls Alexa to inform her that Team Flare is the ones behind the incidents happening in various places. She also informs her sister that Y and her friends have also left to go to Lumiose City. Later, Viola and Alexa witness Lysandre announcing to the entire Kalos region about his plans to end all life with the power of the ultimate weapon. Afterward, they, along with Clemont, [[Bonnie]], and [[Yvette]], confront Team Flare at {{rt|10|Kalos}} in order to free the captured Pokémon there. Together, the group manages to defeat all the members of Team Flare and rescue the captured Pokémon. After Team Flare is fully defeated, Viola and her allies meet with X and his friends at [[Lumiose City]] to congratulate them on their victory. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Vivillon 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Viola |pkmn=Vivillon |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Viola Vivillon Adventures.png |epnum=PS554 |epname=Kangaskhan...Kangascan't |desc=Vivillon debuted in ''[[PS554|Kangaskhan...Kangascan't]]''.
